Florida Woman Plunges 1000 Feet To Her Death While Photographing Italian Alps

An American tourist tragically plummeted nearly 1,000 feet to her death in the Italian Alps while trying to photograph the awe-inspiring scenery there after departing from an established mountain trail.
The post Florida Woman Plunges 1000 Feet To Her Death While Photographing Italian Alps appeared first on Breitbart.

Actual Article Body:
An American tourist tragically plummeted nearly 1,000 feet to her death in the Italian Alps while trying to photograph the awe-inspiring scenery there after departing from an established mountain trail.

The Daily Mail reported Friday that Michaelle Alejandra Rubio Leiva, 36, was exploring the Dolomites with her family last Saturday when she “lost her footing near Forcella Pordoi, a dramatic mountain pass overlooking the resort town of Canazei.”

Leiva, a Florida-based communications professional, apparently strayed from the marked route to seek a more panoramic viewpoint before plunging approximately 980 feet down an exposed section of mountainside, according to the Mail, citing a report by the Italian newspaper Corriere della Sera.

The young woman’s sister reported the incident, triggering an emergency response in the challenging alpine terrain. Help came in the form of mountain first responders and an air ambulance chopper, with rescuers being lowered onto the mountainside around 12:30 p.m. local time.

However, Leiva was pronounced dead at the scene, which was at the 9,000 foot mark.

The family was “making its way towards a cable car station for a journey to the summit of Sass Pordoi, famed for its sweeping views across the surrounding peaks, according to Italian outlet il Dolomiti,” according to the Mail.

Leiva, who was born in Guatemala, graduated from Brigham Young University and was pursuing a career in communications and consulting.

She was most recently employed by a firm in Miami, Corriere della Sera reported, and had also been involved in several volunteer projects.

Actual Article Body:

A Kentucky woman was arrested Thursday on charges of sodomy and incest allegedly involving a minor, court papers showed.

Lauren Winans is accused of sexually abusing and sodomizing a victim younger than 12 sometime between Jan. 1, 2022 and Nov. 20, 2022, according to an indictment returned in Nelson County by a grand jury on Wednesday.

The 31-year-old Bardstown woman, “committed the offense of sodomy in the first degree by engaging in deviate sexual intercourse with C.G.W., a person less than twelve years of age,” the indictment alleged.

The victim in three of the counts was referred to as C.G.W. in the court papers.

Winans is also accused of having sex with a family member who is younger than 12, according to the indictment.

Winans “committed the offense of incest when she had sexual intercourse or deviate sexual intercourse with a person whom she knew to be an ancestor who was less than twelve years of age.”

It was not clear whether the underage family member was the same victim mentioned in the other three charges Winans is facing. It also wasn’t clear how they were related.

Winans has not yet posted the $250,000 bail she is being held on, Nelson County Jailer Justin Hall confirmed to The Post.

She faces up to life in prison if convicted on the top count of first-degree sodomy.

Winans is set to be arraigned on Nov. 5. It was not immediately known who her lawyer is.
